method: deterministic CPU construction assay with synthetic scorer and per-key input intervals

decision_rule.TEMPORALLY_UNIQUE: exactly one intent's verified per-key intervals cover the entire open-closed scorer detection bracket and no other intent could overlap it
decision_rule.AMBIGUOUS: more than one intent could overlap the scorer detection bracket

run_policy: one execution; no game, model, GUI, input, container, or live allocation; preserve first outcome
